:''"I bet a bully I could bring back the tongue of a [[heket]]. But now that I'm out here, it's really scary. I just want to go home. But if I do, the bully will beat me up and tell everyone I'm a coward. Please, you're a great hero. Can you find me 5 [[Heket Tongue]]s? I'll give you whatever I have:" ''
